Wine.name: Fuel
Wine.desc: Add 1 damage to your next attack or heal 1 HP when you are at brink of death

Break.name: Dismantle
Break.desc: Discard a card from the target

Chains.name: Shockwave
Chains.desc: Link 1-2 players or discard to draw 1

Steal.name: Fetch
Steal.desc: Steal a card from the target, they must be in your utility range

Coerce.name: Summon Forth
Coerce.desc: Choose a player with a weapon, make them attack another player or give you the weapon

Blaze.name: Pyre
Blaze.desc: Your target shows a card, you can discard a card of the same suit to do 1 fire damage

Duel.name: Fight Me!
Duel.desc: Your target and you alternately play strikes, whoever stops first takes 1 damage

Harvest.name: Royalties
Harvest.desc: Reveal cards equal to number of players, everyone takes a card

Barbarians.name: Rolling Boulder
Barbarians.desc: Everyone play a strike or take 1 damage

Hail of Arrows.name: Salvo
Hail of Arrows.desc: Everyone play a defend or take 1 damage

Lightning.name: The Bomb
Lightning.desc: Delayed skill: if judgement is 2~9 of spades, take 3 lightning damage

Capture.name: Normality
Capture.desc: Delayed skill: if judgement is not hearts, skip playing phase

Starvation.name: Folly
Starvation.desc: Delayed skill: if judgement is not clubs, skip drawing phase. Target must be in your utility range

Eight Trigrams.name: Toric Toughness
Eight Trigrams.desc: When you need to play a defend, do a judgement, if it is red it counts as you played the defend

Wood Armor.name: Stone Armor
Wood Armor.desc: You are immune to strikes, salvo, rolling boulder. Fire damage you take is increased by 1

Silver Helmet.name: Apparition
Silver Helmet.desc: You can lose at most 1 HP per instance of damage. You heal 1 HP when you lose this card from your equipments

Black Shield.name: Shadow Shield
Black Shield.desc: You are immune to strikes of black suits

Gender Swords.name: Tools of the Trade
Gender Swords.desc: Attack range 2. Strike target of other gender choose to discard 1 or have you draw 1

Black Pommel.name: Sovereign Blade
Black Pommel.desc: Attack range 2. Your strikes ignore armor

Ice Sword.name: Phantom Blades
Ice Sword.desc: Attack range 2. You can prevent damage on your strike to discard 2 instead

Ancient Scimitar.name: Murder
Ancient Scimitar.desc: Attack range 2. If your strike target has no hand cards, strike deals +1 damage

Serpent Spear.name: Serpent Form
Serpent Spear.desc: Attack range 3. You can use two hand cards as strike

Axe.name: Gold Axe
Axe.desc: Attack range 3. You can discard 2 to enforce damage on a defended strike

Green Dragon Blade.name: Adaptive Strike
Green Dragon Blade.desc: Attack range 3. You can strike defending targets again

Fire Fan.name: Inflame
Fire Fan.desc: Attack range 4. You can use strike as a solar strike

Sky Scorcher.name: Fan of Knives
Sky Scorcher.desc: Attack range 4. If your strike is the last card, you can select up to 3 targets

Longbow.name: Tracking
Longbow.desc: Attack range 5. If you strike dealt damage, you can kill a minion or osty

Red Hare.name: Minion Strike
Red Hare.desc: -1 to other players' utility distance from you

Da Yuan.name: Minion Dive Bomb
Da Yuan.desc: -1 to other players' utility distance from you

Zi Xing.name: Minion Sacrifice
Zi Xing.desc: -1 to other players' utility distance from you

Di Lu.name: Afterlife (Osty)
Di Lu.desc: +1 to your utility distance from others

Shadow Runner.name: Spur (Osty)
Shadow Runner.desc: +1 to your utility distance from others

Storm Runner.name: Bodyguard (Osty)
Storm Runner.desc: +1 to your utility distance from others

Hua Liu.name: Reanimate (Osty)
Hua Liu.desc: +1 to your utility distance from others
